Bill.BriefDescription: Creating the universal vaccine purchase account.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating the universal vaccine purchase account;and adding a new section to chapter 43.70 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The universal vaccine purchase account is created in thecustody of the state treasurer. Receipts from private and publicsources for the purpose of increasing access to vaccines for childrenmust be deposited into the account. Expenditures from the account mustbe used for the purchase of vaccines, at no cost to health careproviders in Washington, to administer to children under nineteen yearsold who are not eligible to receive vaccines at no cost through federalprograms. The account is subject to allotment procedures under chapter43.88 RCW, but an appropriation is not required for expenditures. (2) The department shall determine which vaccines shall bepurchased with funds available in the universal vaccine purchaseaccount. The selection of vaccines shall be based on the sufficiencyof amounts available in the account, the significance of the vaccine to p. 1 HB 2342the health of children receiving the vaccine and those who may not bevaccinated, and any recommendations of state or federal immunizationexpert committees. (3) The department shall coordinate purchasing decisions throughfederal programs that receive discounts for the purchase of largequantities of vaccines.
